scientific_integrity: Exact results proved analytically from explicit Markov transition powers and Rayleigh spectral optimization; finite checker is auxiliary, not a proof of infinite statements. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only real bounded orthonormal one-chain finite-memory copula expansions with nonnegative density. Optimize over all square-integrable same-score functions, not restricted monotone scores or general nilpotent copula operators. Classical Kac-Murdock-Szego eigentheory is prior art; unindexed equivalent specialized work may exist.
title: Sharp same-score correlation and variance envelopes for finite-memory copulas
